expression: # Multi-word constructions: the things that make graded prose sound like Chinese
# rather than translated English. Two kinds, distinguished by the `regex` column:
#   - PATTERNS (regex filled) — split constructions the scribe wraps around its
#     own words: 一…就…, 虽然…但是…. These cannot be matched as tokens, so they
#     are detected by regex over the raw text.
#   - SET PHRASES (regex empty) — fixed multi-word chunks matched literally, and
#     loaded into jieba so they segment as one unit.
# `level` obeys the book's level cap exactly like hsk.tsv, so an HSK3 book only
# ever sees HSK1-3 constructions. Real 成语 live in chengyu.tsv (the official
# syllabus puts almost all of them at levels 7-9 — see that file's header).
# The scribe is required to use a minimum number of these per chapter
# (`min_expressions` in plan.json); validate.py counts distinct hits.
